provider: FreeMach — community free VPS (LES/HT/LET members, 3-month account age)

free_tier.stated: US1.KVM: 2 vCPU, 3 GB RAM, 120 GB HDD, 1 TB transfer. EU1.KVM: 2 vCPU, 2 GB, 25 GB SSD, 1 TB. Hosts are a VirMach Buffalo E3-1240v3 with 2x1TB HDD and an AlphaVPS Sofia dual-L5630.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: 1 TB per VM at 1 Gbps. Metered and small.

chaining: Hard-gated on community standing, not on payment: 'LES/HT/LET account must be at least 3 months old at time of application', 'Must pass a FraudRecord check (Do not use a proxy to submit the application)'. That check is a risk-scoring screen. A second account would need an aged forum identity and a clean risk-scoring record, which is the actual scarce resource.
limits_note: 120 GB max disk per VM, 1 TB transfer. Currently 0 slots: 'EU1 (AlphaVPS, Bulgaria): 10/10 VMs Allocated (0 slots free) … US1 (VirMach, New York): 10/10 VMs Allocated (0 slots free)'.
reliability_note: Sponsored capacity on other people's dedicated servers, 10 VMs per node. The risk-scoring screen means a closure follows the person across the low-end host ecosystem. That is the strongest usage-anomaly signal in the niche.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.
